add-semi-transparent-logo-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add Semi-Transparent Logo Stamp to First PDF Page
add-semi-transparent-logo-stamp-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to place a semi‑transparent image (logo) as a stamp on the first page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-stamp-to-pdf-page.title: Add Image Stamp to Page Two
add-image-stamp-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to place an image stamp with 100% quality and 80% opacity on the second page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-stamp-with-alt-text-to-pdf-pag.title: Add Image Stamp with Alt Text to PDF Page
add-image-stamp-with-alt-text-to-pdf-pag.description: Demonstrates how to place an image stamp on the third page of a PDF and assign alternative text for accessibility using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-stamp-floatingbox-page-4.title: Add Image Background to PDF Page Using FloatingBox
add-image-stamp-floatingbox-page-4.description: Demonstrates how to place an image stamp as a full‑page background inside a FloatingBox on the fourth page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-image-stamp-to-all-pdf-pages.title: Apply Image Stamp to All PDF Pages
apply-image-stamp-to-all-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create an ImageStamp, and apply it to every page using a foreach loop before saving the document.

add-rotated-image-stamp-to-pdf.title: Rotate Image Stamp and Add to PDF
add-rotated-image-stamp-to-pdf.description: Shows how to rotate an image stamp by 45 degrees and place it on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

align-image-stamp-top-right-margin.title: Align Image Stamp to Top‑Right Corner with Margins
align-image-stamp-top-right-margin.description: Demonstrates how to place an image stamp in the top‑right corner of each PDF page using Aspose.Pdf, with configurable top and right margin offsets.

scale-image-stamp-full-page-width.title: Apply Full-Width Image Stamp Preserving Aspect Ratio
scale-image-stamp-full-page-width.description: Loads a PNG image, computes its aspect ratio, and adds it as an ImageStamp to every page of a PDF, scaling the stamp to the page width while keeping the original aspect ratio.

add-image-stamp-from-memory-stream-to-pd.title: Add Image Stamp from Memory Stream to PDF
add-image-stamp-from-memory-stream-to-pd.description: Demonstrates how to load an image into a MemoryStream and apply it as an ImageStamp to each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-low-quality-image-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add Low-Quality Image Stamp to PDF
add-low-quality-image-stamp-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates compressing a stamp image to a low‑quality JPEG (10 % quality) in memory and applying it as an ImageStamp to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, improving performance for large documents.

add-opaque-image-watermark-to-pdf.title: Add Fully Opaque Image Stamp Watermark to PDF
add-opaque-image-watermark-to-pdf.description: Shows how to place a fully opaque image stamp as a visual watermark on each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-diagonal-image-watermark-to-pdf.title: Add Diagonal Image Watermark to PDF
add-diagonal-image-watermark-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating an ImageStamp, rotating it 90 degrees, setting opacity, and applying it to each page as a diagonal watermark.

add-upside-down-image-stamp.title: Add Upside-Down Image Stamp to PDF
add-upside-down-image-stamp.description: Shows how to place an image stamp rotated 180 degrees on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

place-image-stamp-custom-coordinates.title: Place Image Stamp at Custom Coordinates in PDF
place-image-stamp-custom-coordinates.description: Shows how to add an image stamp to a PDF page at specific X and Y coordinates using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-stamp-percentage-position.title: Apply Image Stamp with Percentage Offsets to PDF Pages
add-image-stamp-percentage-position.description: Demonstrates how to place an image stamp on each PDF page using offsets expressed as percentages of the page width and height.

fit-image-stamp-within-rectangle.title: Fit Image Stamp Within a Rectangle in PDF
fit-image-stamp-within-rectangle.description: Demonstrates how to place an image stamp so that it automatically fits inside a defined rectangle on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-fixed-size-image-stamp-to-pdf-page.title: Add Fixed-Size Image Stamp to PDF Pages
apply-fixed-size-image-stamp-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to place a PNG image stamp with fixed width, height, and margins on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-stamp-unicode-alt-text.title: Add Image Stamp with Unicode Alt Text to PDF
add-image-stamp-unicode-alt-text.description: Demonstrates how to place an image stamp on every page of a PDF and embed multilingual Unicode alternative text for accessibility.

add-image-stamp-alt-text-pdfa.title: Add Image Stamp with Alternative Text for PDF/A‑1b Output
add-image-stamp-alt-text-pdfa.description: Demonstrates adding an image stamp to each page of a PDF, setting alternative text for the stamp (and other images), and converting the document to PDF/A‑1b compliance using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-stamp-to-encrypted-pdf.title: Add Image Stamp to Encrypted PDF
add-image-stamp-to-encrypted-pdf.description: Shows how to open an encrypted PDF with a password, decrypt it, and apply an image stamp to every page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-stamp-to-signed-pdf.title: Add Image Stamp to Signed PDF Without Invalidating Signature
add-image-stamp-to-signed-pdf.description: Shows how to overlay an image stamp onto a digitally signed PDF using Aspose.Pdf while preserving the existing signature by performing an incremental update.

add-image-stamp-annotation-to-pdf.title: Add Image Stamp to PDF While Preserving Annotations
add-image-stamp-annotation-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating an ImageStamp, and applying it to each page while keeping existing annotations intact.

add-image-stamp-to-pdf-form.title: Add Image Stamp to PDF Form Without Flattening
add-image-stamp-to-pdf-form.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with form fields, creating an ImageStamp, applying it to each page, and saving the document while keeping the form fields interactive.

add-image-stamp-flatten-annotations.title: Add Image Stamp and Flatten Annotations to Create Read‑Only PDF
add-image-stamp-flatten-annotations.description: Demonstrates how to apply an image stamp to every page of a PDF, flatten all existing annotations so they become part of the page content, and save the result as a read‑only document.

add-image-stamp-preserve-bookmarks.title: Add Image Stamp While Preserving Bookmarks
add-image-stamp-preserve-bookmarks.description: Demonstrates how to overlay an image stamp on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf while keeping existing bookmarks and the document outline intact.

add-image-stamp-preserve-page-labels.title: Add Image Stamp While Preserving Page Labels
add-image-stamp-preserve-page-labels.description: Demonstrates how to apply an image stamp to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf while keeping the original /PageLabels dictionary unchanged.

add-image-stamp-preserve-xmp-metadata.title: Add Image Stamp and Preserve Custom XMP Metadata in PDF
add-image-stamp-preserve-xmp-metadata.description: The example loads a PDF, adds a custom XMP metadata property, creates a semi‑transparent image stamp, applies it to every page, and saves the result while preserving the metadata.

add-image-stamp-preserve-embedded-files.title: Add Image Stamp While Preserving Embedded Files
add-image-stamp-preserve-embedded-files.description: Shows how to load a PDF, apply an image stamp to every page, and save the document while keeping any embedded files attached to the original PDF.

add-image-stamp-preserve-javascript.title: Add Image Stamp to PDF While Preserving JavaScript Actions
add-image-stamp-preserve-javascript.description: This example demonstrates how to apply an image stamp to each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf while keeping any existing JavaScript actions intact.

add-image-stamp-preserve-acroform-fields.title: Add Image Stamp While Preserving AcroForm Fields
add-image-stamp-preserve-acroform-fields.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, optionally reading AcroForm field values, applying an ImageStamp to each page, and saving the document while keeping the form fields intact.

add-custom-text-stamp-to-pdf-first-page.title: Add Custom Text Stamp to First PDF Page
add-custom-text-stamp-to-pdf-first-page.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, create a TextStamp with a specific font, size, and blue color, and apply it only to the first page before saving the document.

add-text-stamp-auto-adjust-font.title: Add Text Stamp with Automatic Font Size to PDF
add-text-stamp-auto-adjust-font.description: Shows how to place a TextStamp on each page of a PDF and let Aspose.Pdf automatically calculate the maximum font size that fits within the stamp rectangle.

add-outlined-text-stamp.title: Add Outlined Text Stamp to PDF
add-outlined-text-stamp.description: Loads a PDF, creates a TextStamp with custom font and color to simulate an outlined text effect, positions it on a page, and saves the modified document.

add-bold-outlined-text-stamp.title: Add Bold Outlined Text Stamp to PDF
add-bold-outlined-text-stamp.description: Shows how to create a centered bold text stamp and apply it to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-bottom-left-text-stamp.title: Align Text Stamp to Bottom‑Left Corner with Margin
add-bottom-left-text-stamp.description: Demonstrates how to place a text stamp at the bottom‑left of each PDF page using Aspose.Pdf, with a 10‑point left and bottom margin.

add-rotated-text-watermark.title: Add Rotated Text Watermark to PDF
add-rotated-text-watermark.description: Demonstrates creating a TextStamp, rotating it 30 degrees, setting opacity and style, and applying it as a watermark to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-confidential-text-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add Confidential Text Stamp to PDF
add-confidential-text-stamp-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, create a semi‑transparent 'Confidential' text stamp, apply it to each page, and save the modified document.

add-text-stamp-with-background-box.title: Add Text Stamp with Background Box to PDF
add-text-stamp-with-background-box.description: Demonstrates how to place a semi‑transparent text stamp with a colored background rectangle on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-multi-line-text-stamp.title: Add Multi‑Line Disclaimer Text Stamp with Custom Line Spacing
add-multi-line-text-stamp.description: Demonstrates how to add a multi‑line text stamp (disclaimer) to each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, including custom line spacing and a semi‑transparent background.

add-rtl-text-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add RTL Text Stamp to PDF
add-rtl-text-stamp-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create a right‑to‑left language text stamp using a Unicode font and apply it to every page of a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.

add-full-page-image-watermark-to-pdf.title: Add Full-Page Text Watermark to PDF
add-full-page-image-watermark-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a TextStamp as a background watermark that covers the entire page and apply it to each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-diagonal-text-stamp-watermark.title: Add Diagonal Text Stamp Watermark to PDF
add-diagonal-text-stamp-watermark.description: Shows how to place a 45‑degree semi‑transparent text stamp on every page of a PDF as a diagonal watermark using Aspose.Pdf.

add-background-image-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add Background Image Stamp to PDF Pages
add-background-image-stamp-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to place an image stamp behind the existing content of each page in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-faint-overlay-stamp-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Image Stamp with Opacity to PDF Pages
add-faint-overlay-stamp-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to overlay an image stamp with 40% opacity on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-rotated-text-stamp-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Rotated Image Stamp to PDF Pages
add-rotated-text-stamp-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating an ImageStamp, rotating it 90 degrees to match portrait‑to‑landscape pages, and applying the stamp to every page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-custom-sized-page-stamp.title: Add Image Stamp with Custom Size to Specific PDF Page
add-custom-sized-page-stamp.description: Demonstrates how to add an image stamp with custom width, height, and position to a specific page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-page-stamp-to-specific-pdf-pages.title: Add Image Stamp to Pages 5‑10 of a PDF
add-page-stamp-to-specific-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, creating an ImageStamp, and applying it to a specific page range (pages 5 through 10) before saving the result.

add-global-text-stamp-to-all-pdf-pages.title: Add Image Stamp to All PDF Pages
add-global-text-stamp-to-all-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create an ImageStamp, apply it to every page with Page.AddStamp, and save the stamped document.

create-page-stamp-from-existing-pdf-page.title: Create Page Stamp from PDF Page
create-page-stamp-from-existing-pdf-page.description: Shows how to convert a PDF page to an image and use it as an image stamp applied to every page of another PDF document.

apply-pdf-page-background-stamp.title: Apply PDF Page as Background Image Stamp
apply-pdf-page-background-stamp.description: Demonstrates rendering a page from one PDF to an image and stamping it as a background on every page of another PDF using Aspose.Pdf.
